notes: I changed the suppression rule from "starts with h AND all letters lowercase" to simply "first character is lowercase 'h'". E20 shows `hEllo`, `h2ello`, `hEllo1` are suppressed (start with lowercase h) while `Hello`, `HELLO`, `Hallo`, `Hullo`, `H2ello` are not (start with uppercase H), and `hEllo1` proves ending in o/y isn't required.
